title: Drunken Sailor
attribution: Anonymous capstan shanty sung on British and American ships since at least the 1830s (first described in an account of an 1839 whaling voyage); words as printed in R. R. Terry's The Shanty Book (1921). Traditional melody and words, public domain worldwide. The tune is in the Dorian mode, so the B natural on "drunken sailor" (third line) is expected to show as out-of-key.
